notes.title: Response to feedback
notes.content:
[b]Balance:[/b]
- +50% damage

[b]QoL:[/b]
- parrying while being close to the damage is now more forgiving
- dash now leaves you hanging less time

[b]bugs:[/b]
- enemies AI should now stop getting stuck
